title: HullQ Organization v0.1
description: A real organization such as a shipyard, manufacturer, or builder. Separate first-class identity from Brand/Marque (ADR-0011). The same visible name does not force identity collapse with a Brand that uses the same word.

id.description: Stable opaque HullQ Organization ID, independent of name.

canonical_name.description: Canonical HullQ display name. Corporate suffixes and country annotations must not be removed from this field; stripping is a search-projection concern only.

aliases.description: Entity-scoped aliases. Must not contain Brand aliases.
